=== Round 1 ===
Step 1
1. Player 1 plays Battlefield Marine.
Step 2
1. Player 2 plays Bodhi Rook, Imperial Defector.
   a. Player 2's Bodhi Rook, Imperial Defector triggers.
      a. Player 2 looks at New Tactics and Rebel Assault.
      b. Player 1 discards Rebel Assault.
Step 3
1. Player 1 passes.
Step 4
1. Player 2 plays Trust Yourself on Bodhi Rook, Imperial Defector.
   a. Player 2 searches their deck with Trust Yourself, seeing Spark of Rebellion, Cantina Bouncer and Strafing Gunship, taking Strafing Gunship.
   b. Player 2 draws Strafing Gunship.
Step 5
1. Player 1 plays New Tactics on Bodhi Rook, Imperial Defector.
   a. Player 2 chooses: Top of the deck.
   b. Shield is defeated by New Tactics.
Step 6
1. Player 2 passes.
Step 7
1. Player 1 passes.
2. The regroup phase begins.
   a. Player 1 draws Swoop Racer and Gamorrean Guards.
   b. Player 2 draws Bodhi Rook, Imperial Defector and Smuggling Compartment.
   c. (step 8) Player 1 resources Swoop Racer.
